name: A HANDFUL OF OATS
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. From Grievance's feed bin at the livery. The hen eats them.

LOOK_AT.say: Grievance's oats, a handful, loose in my pocket with everything else I owe for.
repeat: Good oats. She eats better than the hotel serves, and with less comment.
Fewer than there were. My pocket has a hole in it, and so, I begin to think, has my character.

LISTEN_TO.say: A dry whisper, like a jury.
repeat: Nothing. Oats are patient. It is the mule who is not.
A trickle, down the lining of my coat.
